extensions.title: Air Quality
extensions.description: The air anywhere as a card while you type: the US AQI with its band and the pollutants behind it, from Open-Meteo.
extensions.author: vlad-terin
extensions.readme:
# Air Quality

A card under the field as you type: the air quality somewhere right now. It
shows the US AQI with its band ("Good", "Unhealthy for sensitive groups", …),
what the band means for being outside, and the pollutants behind it (PM2.5,
PM10, ozone, NO₂). From [Open-Meteo](https://open-meteo.com), no key. A place
is looked up once; a reading is kept an hour.

## Type

- “air quality berlin”
- “aqi delhi”
- “air quality in san francisco”

↵ copies the line: `Berlin: AQI 34, good`.

## Reaches

geocoding-api.open-meteo.com and air-quality-api.open-meteo.com. It changes
nothing.

lines: First version: a card, from Open-Meteo.

extensions.title: DNS Lookup
extensions.description: A domain's DNS records as a card while you type - addresses, mail, name servers - asked of your Mac's own resolver.
extensions.author: vlad-terin
extensions.readme:
# DNS Lookup

A card under the field as you type: a domain's DNS records. It shows A, AAAA,
CNAME, MX and NS, plus how many TXT records it has (and whether one is SPF).
They come from your Mac's own resolver, so nothing is sent anywhere but the
lookups themselves.

## Type

- “dns github.com”
- “nslookup mail.google.com”

↵ copies every record, one per line.

The card needs a domain after the word, so “flush dns” and “dns cache” stay
Jevie's own. “dig” is Jevie's file finder, so it is not this card's.

## Reaches

The DNS servers your Mac uses. It changes nothing.

lines: First version: a card, from the Mac's resolver.
